utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Perris' by name among the cities in its service area.

generation_supplier.notes: Perris is a named member city of Western Community Energy (WCE), but WCE deregistered with the CPUC and dissolved via Chapter 9 bankruptcy in 2021, with customers involuntarily returned to their default IOU. No currently-operating CCA was confirmed serving Perris this session, so left null rather than recording a defunct relationship as active.

permit_authority.value: City of Perris Development Services Department, Building Department

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Perris/Riverside County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.
